entries.title: Pip's Bike Won't Move! Which Fix Works?

moments.what: The problem: the class ride is in one hour and the bike won't move
Pick the fix: pedal harder, a skipping rope, or the chain?
Fix 1: pedal harder. One part cannot do another part's job
Fix 2: a skipping rope round the gears
Look closer: the chain's function, teeth in the gaps
Journey: be a link of the bike chain
Can it stop? Every part has its own function
One part stops working: the system is likely to be affected
Your body is made up of systems too
A tree is a system: leaves, stem and roots
